get.description:
Public, read-only (T5.10, D055). Must stay registered before
`/decisions/{id}` below -- Starlette matches routes in registration
order, and `{id}` would otherwise swallow the literal "verify-chain"
path and 404 as "not_found" instead of reaching this handler.

post.description: T7.4 (D059): audited allowlist append from an R01 FRENAR record (I2).

get.description: Read-only «x de N» status (T7.1, D059 §4). Never mutates `decision` (I2).

schema.title: Response Openapi Json Openapi Json Get

AmountRange.title: AmountRange
AmountRange.description: Expected amount window for a calendar-periodicity series (T7.2 §2).

ApprovalPolicy.title: ApprovalPolicy
ApprovalPolicy.description: Routes evaluated in order; first match wins (T7.1 §2). Last route is catch-all.

Extraction.title: Extraction
Extraction.description: Raw extract. None means missing; T2 escalates. amount_base and fx are filled by T2.2.

HumanDecisionBody.title: HumanDecisionBody
HumanDecisionBody.description: Author and reason only. The client does not send `at` or a new decision.

JevThresholds.title: JevThresholds
JevThresholds.description: J1, J2, J3, J4, J6, J7 only. J5 is not a payment threshold.

OnFail.title: OnFail
OnFail.description:
R01–R13 (required), plus R14 (optional, additive per T7.1/D059).

Values are only FRENAR or ESCALAR. ``R14`` defaults to ``ESCALAR`` so
every existing rules package without the key keeps parsing unchanged.

PaymentSeries.title: PaymentSeries
PaymentSeries.description:
Declared payment calendar for one vendor (T7.2 §2, D059).

`monthly`/`biweekly`/`quarterly` are calendar periodicities: they need
`expected_amount` and `start` (an open-ended `end` means no upper bound).
`installments`/`milestones` instead declare an explicit, non-empty
`items` list with their own per-item amount and window.

PricingTerms.title: PricingTerms
PricingTerms.description: Declared variable-pricing formula for one vendor (T7.3 §2, D059).

RouteMatch.title: RouteMatch
RouteMatch.description: All present fields combine with AND (T7.1 §2). Empty means catch-all.

RouteRequire.title: RouteRequire
RouteRequire.description: `auto` adds nothing; `approvals` needs >=1 approvals from non-empty groups.

VendorOnboarding.title: VendorOnboarding
VendorOnboarding.description: Optional audited vendor allowlist from R01 failures (T7.4 §2, D059).
